svg.text: Proposition 1 (Degree-3 MBU Barrier & Degree-2 Exact Criterion):

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • After H|f(x)⟩ followed by M_X = m in {0,1}, residual phase state is (-1)^{m * f(x)} |x⟩.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • For Temporary-AND f(a',b') = a' * b' (deg = 2): (-1)^{a'*b'} = CZ(a', b') → 0 Toffolis!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • For 3-way AND f(x1,x2,x3) = x1*x2*x3 (deg = 3): phase is CCZ(x1,x2,x3), which lies

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Strictly Outside C_2 (Clifford hierarchy level 3). Any Clifford fixup C in C_2 satisfies:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif
'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Consequence: Binary fan-in = 2 trees (BraunTree, Cuccaro-Gidney, Crit-Bit) hit the

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: exact 50% MBU Toffoli savings frontier; higher-arity fan-in > 2 requires T-gate uncompute.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Qubit Width Recurrence Proof (Depth h = 9 Binary XMSS Subtree, n = 256 bits):

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Simultaneous (Out-of-Place): Holds |v_L⟩ AND |v_R⟩ concurrently before parent hash:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif
'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Sequential Two-Phase (Zipper): Absorbs |v_L⟩ into sponge |z⟩, uncomputes U_L† → |0⟩^n:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Q_seq(h) = Q_seq(h-1) + n ⟹ (h + 1)*n = 10 * 256 = 2,560 tree Q (4,320 Q total)
